actions.note: Site actions are registered in app.js (SITE_ACTIONS) and discovered from the live page by AgentifyJS (data-agent-action attributes). The runtime validates arguments against JSON Schema and asks the user to confirm every write.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.

brand: The Book Nook — an open agentic bookshop

llm_router.note: No publisher-funded inference: the site runs on a built-in deterministic demo model by default. Visitors may bring their own key for any OpenAI-compatible router (OpenAI, OpenRouter, …) — the key stays in their browser.

networks.description: Ask about the catalog, build your cart, place a demo pickup or delivery order, or check an order's status.
networks.name: booknook_assistant
sample_queries: What fantasy books do you have?
Add two copies of The Glass Meridian to my cart
Check out for pickup, name Ada
What is the status of my latest order?

peer_policy.note: Only the Harbor Delivery Co. peer origin may be contacted, and only after the visitor approves the contact. The peer runs in the visitor's browser on the visitor's model and never receives the visitor's API key.
